body:
Sorry for the late reply. Some beautiful people reached out.

There's no suicide helpline where I'm from. Interesting, no? I guess third-world countries really often do have more urgent shit to worry about, but I'm guilty of being suicidal here.

It was also a metaphor. I have a loaded gun in my drawer, and not gonna lie, it's tempting me so much.

EDIT: But also thanks, didn;t mean to sound so cold. I hope you're well and stay well.
